chapters.reason: The paper explicitly improves Best-of-N sampling, which is a core parallel search technique, by introducing speculative rejection to prune candidates.
The paper focuses on optimizing inference-time compute scaling for Best-of-N, which is a primary method for test-time compute allocation.
The speculative rejection mechanism functions similarly to speculative decoding by using a faster, lighter process to verify or reject candidates, aligning with model-switching logic.
